_why: Android rendering had ZERO screenshots anywhere — every one of the 424 planned shots drove the desktop Electron workbench with no mobile platform switch (completeness-screens.md, 2026-09-23 audit). `?platform=android` (install-mock.ts declarePlatform, existing switch, listed in README's 'Workbench switches') sets `window.__PLATFORM__='android'` before the app mounts, so every render-time `getPlatform()`/`isAndroid()` branch in the SHARED React code sees Android — the header drops its window buttons and the shell narrows the way the real phone app does; its own caveat says to film it at the real narrow width (390) because an import-time const (HeaderBar's toggleOnLeft) only reads correctly there. This is still Chrome/desktop rendering the shared bundle, NOT the actual Android WebView/Kotlin runtime — no native system chrome, safe-area insets, or the native first-run/auth paths, which stay unreachable without a real device or emulator build. `?platform=android` is a real, existing switch; no code was changed to add this plan.
